verdict.rationale: Serving LoRA adapters is a fair question for a local model-serving runtime like Ollama, but nothing in the evidence mentions LoRA, adapters, or serving several adapters over one base model. Running multiple models concurrently and hot-swapping models are related features, not adapter serving, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can efficiently serve multiple LoRA adapters on top of a base model
